Village Rites.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
Draw two cards.

Deadly Dispute.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice an artifact or creature.
Draw two cards and create a Treasure token. (It's an artifact with "{T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Add one mana of any color.")

Tend the Pests.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
Create X 1/1 black and green Pest creature tokens with "When this creature dies, you gain 1 life," where X is the sacrificed creature's power.

Nature's Lore.oracle_text: Search your library for a Forest card, put that card onto the battlefield, then shuffle.

Sakura-Tribe Elder.oracle_text: Sacrifice this creature: Search your library for a basic land card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
